tagline: Talk to someone new, right now
speaker: Speaker
partner_dropped: Connection to %1$s dropped. Finding someone new…
mic_needed: TalkLive needs the microphone to talk. Allow it in Settings.
banned: Your access is paused. Contact support if this is a mistake.
report_body: They will be disconnected and you will not be matched again.
notif_searching: Looking for someone to talk to
welcome_1_body: One tap and you are talking to someone new. Voice only, no camera.
welcome_2_body: People from around the world are online right now. Talk, practise a language, make friends.
welcome_3_body: Nobody sees your name or number. Skip anyone, and report in one tap.
choose_body: Create an account to keep your friends and chats on every device.
terms_note: By continuing you confirm you are 18+ and agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.
signup_email_body: We will send a code to confirm it. It is never shown to anyone.
signup_account_body: Pick a username and a password you will remember.
signup_code_body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to %1$s
username_hint: 3–24 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores
login_body: Log in to get your friends and chats back.
chats_empty_body: Have a great call? Add them as a friend and your messages show up here.
friends_empty_body: Start a call and tap Add friend when you get on well with someone.
animal_body: Strangers see it the moment you connect. It is an easy way to say hi.
on_hold: On hold while you are on another call
guest_pitch: Create an account to keep your friends, chats and spirit animal on every device.
display_name_body: This is the name people see when you talk.
recovery_email_body: Used only to send you a code if you forget your password.
reset_body: Enter your account email and we will send you a 6-digit code.
reset_new_body: Make it at least 8 characters. You will be signed in right after.
share_id_text: Talk to me on TalkLive! My friend ID is %1$s  https://talklive.app
remove_body: You can still see your past messages. You can add each other again later.
block_body: They will not be able to message or call you, and you will not be matched again.
say_hi: Say hi and start a conversation
add_to_message: Add %1$s as a friend to keep talking
waiting_accept: Waiting for %1$s to accept your request
channel_calls_desc: When a friend wants to talk to you
icebreaker_hint: Not sure what to say? Tap one to send it
match_body: You and %1$s both tapped the heart.
clear_chat_body: Messages are removed from your phone only. They can still see theirs.
activity_empty: Missed calls and accepted requests show up here.
show_online_desc: Friends see a green dot and when you were last here
allow_calls_desc: Turn off to stop friends ringing you
blocked_body: They cannot message, call or be matched with you.
friend_id_body: Pick a name and 4 numbers, like anakin#1101. Friends can find you with it.
warning_default: Your recent behaviour broke our community guidelines. Please be respectful.
streak_done: Today counts. Come back tomorrow to keep it going.
streak_todo: Have a call of 30 seconds or more today to keep your streak.
passport_body: A stamp for every country you have talked to.
fav_films_body: Pick up to 3. People you meet see them on your card.
apple_credit: Posters and links from Apple TV.
filters_body: Who you would like to meet. If nobody matches for a while, you are matched with anyone.
likes_empty: Tap the heart on a call and they might tap it back.
likes_locked: People from %1$s liked you. TalkLive Plus shows who.
invite_body: Get free TalkLive Plus for every %1$d friends who join and have a real conversation.
invite_progress: %1$d of %2$d toward your next reward · %3$d joined · %4$d hours of Plus earned
invite_share_text: Come talk with me on TalkLive, free voice chat with people worldwide: %1$s
feedback_body: Ideas, bugs, anything. The team reads every message.
plus_terms: Renews automatically until you cancel in Google Play. Cancel any time.
plus_sign_in: Sign in first, so Plus stays with your account on any phone or on talklive.app.
plus_unavailable: Plus can't be bought on this device right now. Check that Google Play is installed and signed in.
plus_pending: Your payment is pending. Plus turns on when Google Play confirms it.
plus_later: Payment received. Plus turns on as soon as TalkLive confirms it.
plus_failed: Something went wrong. You were not charged twice; try again.
plus_nothing_to_restore: No Plus purchase on this Google account.
plus_inactive: Gender filter, see who liked you, undo skip
voice_asked: %1$s wants to send you voice messages

undo_busy: They are already talking to someone else
undo_gone: Too late to bring them back
game_declined: %1$s does not want to play right now.
voice_invite_title: %1$s wants to switch to a voice call
voice_invite_body: You will keep talking to the same person, out loud.
support_offline: We usually reply within a day, by email too
support_greeting: Hi! How can we help? Tell us what happened and we will get back to you.
support_email_hint: So we can reply if you leave the app
t_voice_declined: They would rather keep to text for now
t_unblocked_friend: Unblocked, and back in your friends
t_call_later_ok: We will let them know you want to talk
t_calls_off: They are not taking calls right now
t_couldnt_send: Could not send that right now
t_offline_told: They are offline. We will let them know you called.
t_busy_told: They are on another call. We will let them know.
t_too_many_calls: Too many calls. Try again in a minute.
t_couldnt_reach: Could not reach them right now
t_reported: Reported. You will not be matched again.
f_needs_consent: They have not allowed voice messages
f_voice_rate: Too many voice messages, wait a minute
f_rate: You are sending messages too fast
f_request_first: Add them as a friend to message

voice_check_confirmed: Confirmed: your voice matches the gender you picked.
voice_check_unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm. You won't appear in Voice-checked only matches.
plus_perk_gender_body: Choose women or men, and as many countries as you like.
plus_perk_likes_body: See who tapped the heart, and call them back while they are online.
plus_perk_undo_body: Skipped someone by mistake? Bring them back.
plus_perk_queue_body: Get matched first when it is busy.
plus_hero: Meet the people you want to meet, faster.
plus_hero_active: Plus is on. Thanks for supporting TalkLive.
plus_earn_body: Invite 3 friends who join and talk: you get Plus time.
sounds_desc: Little sounds for matches, messages and games
fallback_random: Nobody fits your filters right now, so you are being matched with anyone.
feedback_reply_title: A reply from the TalkLive team
films_none: Nothing found. Try the original title.
plus_card_pitch: Every filter, see who liked you, undo skips
filters_interests_hint: We try to match you with people who like the same things.
filters_countries_hint: Free: up to %1$d countries in each list.
filters_countries_hint_plus: As many countries as you like.
filters_gender_hint: Choosing women or men comes with 💎 Plus.
streak_lost_body: Missed a day? TalkLive Plus brings your streak back, once a month.
setup_about_body: Both are optional. They help filters find the right people.
setup_about_privacy: Never shown to anyone you talk to.
setup_done_body: %1$s is ready to say hi. Tap Start and meet someone new.

name_needs_account: Create a free account to choose your own name.

n_accepted_body: Say hello: you can message them any time.
plus_perk_streak_body: Missed a day? Bring your streak back, once a month.
